# AROFi — WiFi Hotspot Billing and Network Operations
# Machine-readable public product summary

> AROFi is a cloud platform by AROSOFT Innovations Ltd for businesses that sell internet access through MikroTik routers. It combines captive-portal checkout, Mobile Money, vouchers, QR redemption, RADIUS access, router monitoring, agents, wallets and reports.

## Official Information

- Website: https://arofi.net
- Visual handbook: https://arofi.net/docs
- Company: AROSOFT Innovations Ltd, Kampala, Uganda
- Support: support@arofi.net | +256 787 726 388
- Primary market: Uganda and East Africa
- Primary language: English

## Current Capabilities

- MikroTik HotSpot and RADIUS authentication
- Captive-portal package checkout
- MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money collection through an approved gateway
- Voucher generation, PDF preview, download and sharing
- QR voucher redemption
- Main-owner and agent voucher stock
- Agent and location sales accountability
- Realtime sales and stock dashboard
- Wallet, withdrawal and settlement records
- Router fleet and active-session monitoring
- Secure remote MikroTik access when configured
- CSV, Excel and PDF reporting
- Isolated multi-tenant business workspaces

## Current Public Pricing (UGX)

| Plan | Subscription | Gateway Fee | Voucher Fee |
|------|--------------|-------------|-------------|
| Starter | UGX 0 | 3–8% | 2% |
| Pro | UGX 20,000 per month | 3–5% | 0% |

The exact gateway fee within the published range depends on the active production payment route and provider arrangement. The application Billing screen displays the applicable plan and charges.

## Payment Gateways

AROFi currently supports integration code for:

- Yo! Uganda
- ioTec Pay
- Direct MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money APIs

Production transactions require approved live credentials, callback or webhook configuration, sufficient wallet balance or float where applicable, and provider compliance approval. Withdrawals are not guaranteed to be instant and remain subject to provider processing, limits and account controls.

The canonical documentation is the visual page-by-page handbook at https://arofi.net/docs. It includes:

- Packages and professional status controls
- Mobile Money and card checkout
- Voucher printing and QR redemption
- Agents, locations and stock accountability
- Live sales dashboard
- Wallets and withdrawals
- Payment gateways
- Current pricing
- Reports and exports
- Troubleshooting and production verification

Legacy documentation URLs redirect into the matching handbook chapter.
